name: Lumax Industries Ltd
tagline: Auto-lighting (headlamp/tail-lamp) Tier-1 supplier via a long-standing JV with Stanley Electric (Japan), riding rising LED content-per-vehicle - a decent but already fairly-valued mid-cap compounder, not a 10x/100x setup.
business_overview: Lumax Industries manufactures automotive lighting systems (headlamps, tail-lamps, LED modules) for Indian OEMs (Maruti, Tata, M&M, Honda, Yamaha among others) under a technology/JV relationship with Stanley Electric Co. (Japan). Growth is driven by rising LED penetration and content-per-vehicle premiumisation across 2W/PV segments rather than a new structural inflection. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@ParthaAwe, bullish/medium conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: P/E ~32.6x trailing - full for the growth rate
fundamentals_narrative: Lumax has genuinely outgrown the auto-ancillary industry median on revenue CAGR (~24% vs ~14%), largely on LED/premium-lighting mix-shift and content-per-vehicle gains via its Stanley Electric JV. But the stock has already re-rated hard (52-week range Rs 4,055-6,970) to a full ~32.6x trailing P/E, and detailed ROCE/debt figures were not cleanly available this pass - flagged as a gap. No named management/structural inflection (new CEO, capital-allocation shift, regulatory catalyst) was found; this reads as steady share-gain in a maturing lighting-premiumisation cycle, not a step-change.
